prompt: Cinematic still, 9:16 vertical, medium wide shot, static, camera facing the sofa straight-on, same living room and same framing as the quarrel-start shot. A bright, airy neutral-warm living room, ceiling light on, soft diffuse daylight, no dim moody lamp. On the two-seat sofa, the realistic East Asian Chinese man about 30 to 35 years old (identity from the reference man), short neat dark hair, light-grey crew-neck top, leans in close from the RIGHT still coaxing, pulling a goofy playful face and reaching to tickle her side. The realistic East Asian Chinese woman about 30 to 35 years old (identity from the reference woman), shoulder-length loose dark brown hair, oatmeal-beige knit top, can no longer hold it in: corners of her mouth break into a warm burst-out laugh, she turns her body back toward him and leans in, the empty gap between them now closed. Warm happy candid moment. Matte skin with realistic pores, fine film grain, shot on an iPhone with true-to-life handheld realism, no oily facial glare, no highlight on faces, no plastic AI sheen, no wax. They are Chinese with East Asian faces, not western faces. Bright natural neutral-warm color, shallow depth of field. No text, no subtitles, no logo, no watermark, no brand anywhere.
